{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Vertex : Type where
  | v (i : Nat)

inductive Edge : Type where
  | e (u : Vertex) (v : Vertex) (cost : Int)

inductive DistVal : Type where
  | finite (d : Int)
  | negInf
  | null

inductive Graph : Type where
  | g (n : Nat) (source : Vertex) (edges : List Edge)

def valid (g : Graph) : Prop :=
  match g with
  | Graph.g n src es =>
    1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 10 ∧
    (match src with
     | Vertex.v i => i < n
     end) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ es,
      match e with
      | Edge.e u v c =>
        (match u with | Vertex.v i => i < n end) ∧
        (match v with | Vertex.v j => j < n end) ∧
        (-6 : Int) ≤ c ∧ c ≤ 9
      end)
  end

def solve (g : Graph) : List DistVal :=
  match g with
  | Graph.g n src es =>
    List.replicate n DistVal.null
  end

def outputLen (g : Graph) : Nat :=
  match g with
  | Graph.g n _ _ => n
  end

def outputAt (g : Graph) (i : Nat) : DistVal :=
  match g with
  | Graph.g n src es =>
    if i < n then DistVal.null else DistVal.null
  end

theorem thm_O1 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) :
  (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) = (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) :
  (match g with | Graph.g n src es =>
    match src with
    | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i
    end
  end) = DistVal.finite 0 := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) :
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => i < (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) end) →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i end) = DistVal.negInf →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i end) = DistVal.negInf := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) :
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => i < (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) end) →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i end) = DistVal.null →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i end) = DistVal.null := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (v : Vertex) :
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => i < (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) end) →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i end) = DistVal.finite 0 →
  (match v with | Vertex.v i => outputAt g i end) = DistVal.finite 0 := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) :
  (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) = (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) := by sorry

theorem thm_O7 (g : Graph) (h : valid g) (i : Nat) :
  (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) = (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (g : Graph), valid g ∧
  (match g with | Graph.g n _ _ => n end) = 1 ∧
  (match g with | Graph.g n src es =>
    match src with
    | Vertex.v i => i = 0
    end
  end) := by sorry

end Contract",
